# Zoetrope

> Scroll-scrubbed video that doesn't stutter.

Zoetrope pre-compiles `.mp4`/`.mov` clips with FFmpeg into multi-resolution WebP (or AVIF/JPEG) frame sequences and a `manifest.json`, then streams, caches (`DirectionalLRUCache` + `BlobCache`), decodes (`ImageBitmap`), and renders frames onto an HTML5 `<canvas>` driven by scroll progress (`Zoetrope`, `ZoetropeComposition`).

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview, quick start, integration paths, and feature status.
- [Integration Guide](documentation/integration-guide.md): Vanilla JS, React, Next.js, reduced-motion, and lifecycle teardown.
- [Compiler Reference](documentation/compiler.md): `zoetrope` CLI flags and Node API (`compile`, `validateManifestFile`).
- [Deployment Guide](documentation/deployment.md): Cache-Control and CORS headers for Netlify, Vercel, and Cloudflare.
- [Feature Status Matrix](documentation/feature-status.md): Verified vs. experimental vs. unverified capabilities.
- [Asset Format (CEPK)](documentation/asset-format.md): Experimental CEPK v1 binary container specification.
- [Workspace Guide](documentation/workspace.md): Monorepo layout, `.artifacts/`, and clean commands.
- [Manifest JSON Schema](schema/v1.json): Draft 2020-12 schema for `manifest.json`.
